description: Puppy pose with some adoptable pups!  Take a class and maybe take home a furry friend!
long_description:
Puppy pose with some adoptable pups! Take a class and maybe take home a furry friend!

About this Event

⭐️BYOM: Bring Your Own Mat or Rent One for $5⭐️
Come puppy pose with us @ 
Class starts at 2pm, be sure to arrive 10-15 minutes early for the class to sign our waiver, or sign here before you attend!
Class is 45 minutes long, there will be adoptable rescue puppies playing and relaxing on and around your mat all lesson! You will have 15 minutes after class to take pictures, play and fill out adoption applications!
✨All Ages Welcome✨
Checkout New Leash on Life Animal Rescue!
You can fill out an adoption application here !

Also check out other in Nashville, Workshops in Nashville, Health & Wellness events in Nashville.
